fact_check_verdict: PASS WITH CONDITIONS. One adversarial validator read STAT (Katie Palmer, November 24th) by targeted verbatim extraction, the CMS Rural Health Transformation release (August 25th), the RapidAI / Alaska Stroke Coalition release (September 4th, 2024) and two Alaska DOH RHTP releases. Conditions: (1) two STAT cases are separate, the under-30-minute call, the two-minutes-before-the-report and the 4 hours 23 minutes belong to a man in his mid-60s at an interior hospital about 300 miles from Anchorage, and nobody is said to be flown; (2) the 45 minutes was the time to SEND images to Anchorage, could take, before the software; (3) 21 hospitals plus 2 clinics is PLANNED (will have); (4) the 30 percent is early unpublished data per STAT, arrival in Anchorage to the start of the device; (5) five neurointerventionalists in the entire state, never 'all in Anchorage'; (6) CMS 'over $3.1 million' names no recipient and no vendor, STAT says $3.2 million to the coalition, use CMS wording; (7) a doctor (not 'a radiologist') still reviews every output; (8) no outcome claims, the coalition says it can't show statistically significant benefit; (9) RapidAI named once as the product, not promoted.

claims.spoken: Alaska hospitals are using A I software called RapidAI to read stroke scans.
claims.verbatim_source: "21 acute care hospitals and two CT scan-enabled clinics with RapidAI's stroke system in place."
requires: name the product once, never promote it

claims.spoken: It looks for a large vessel occlusion, a clot blocking a big artery in the brain.
claims.verbatim_source: "there are false positives — scans that the app will say show a large vessel occlusion that actually don't"
requires: suspected, a flag, not a diagnosis

claims.spoken: In one case the app alerted the doctor seconds after the scan was complete.
claims.verbatim_source: "The app alerted the doctor with the results just seconds after the scan was complete"
requires: one case, per STAT, not a spec

claims.spoken: The results went to the local team and to the faraway clot specialists at the same time.
claims.verbatim_source: "the results went out to his local team of doctors and the faraway network of neurointerventionalists."

claims.spoken: Every minute without blood flow, about two million brain cells die.
claims.verbatim_source: "Every minute without blood flow, 2 million brain cells die."

claims.spoken: Alaska has five doctors who can pull out those clots, in the entire state.
claims.verbatim_source: "one of the five neurointerventionalists in the entire state who can extract clots"

claims.spoken: Before the software, just sending the images to Anchorage could take forty-five minutes.
claims.verbatim_source: "it could take 45 precious minutes just to send those thousands of two-dimensional brain snapshots"

claims.spoken: The network runs from Utqiagvik in the far north to Juneau in the south.
claims.verbatim_source: "from Alaska's very northernmost tip in Utqiagvik, all the way south to the state's capital of Juneau"
requires: the ends of the network, not named grantee sites

claims.spoken: Each of those six hospitals says it wants to keep it and pay for it.
claims.on_screen: ALL 6 SAY THEY'LL KEEP AND PAY
claims.verbatim_source: "Each one of the six hospitals that got free access to RapidAI has said it wants to keep and pay for it."

claims.spoken: Federal Rural Health Transformation money, over three point one million dollars, goes to a statewide A I imaging network.
claims.on_screen: OVER $3.1M · FEDERAL RURAL HEALTH MONEY · CMS
claims.verbatim_source: "Over $3.1 million to establish a statewide AI imaging network across 21 acute care hospitals."

claims.spoken: The plan is twenty-one acute care hospitals, plus two clinics with scanners.
claims.verbatim_source: "21 acute care hospitals and two CT scan-enabled clinics with RapidAI's stroke system in place."

claims.spoken: One morning, a man in his sixties fell and came into a hospital in Alaska's interior.
claims.on_screen: MID-60s · A MORNING FALL · INTERIOR HOSPITAL
claims.verbatim_source: "had arrived at a nearby emergency room after a morning fall"
requires: about 300 miles from Anchorage if a distance is drawn

claims.spoken: Less than half an hour after he arrived, the team called Anchorage for a transfer.
claims.verbatim_source: "Less than a half hour after the patient arrived at his local ER, the team had called Providence for a transfer."
requires: the call is to Providence in Anchorage

claims.spoken: That call came two minutes before the official scan report.
claims.verbatim_source: "two minutes before their on-call radiologist even delivered their official CT report"

claims.spoken: Four hours and twenty-three minutes after he arrived, the clot was out.
claims.verbatim_source: "Four hours and 23 minutes later, the clot was out."
requires: measured from his arrival at the local ER

claims.spoken: Early data shows about a thirty percent faster start on clot removal once patients reach Anchorage.
claims.on_screen: ABOUT 30% FASTER START · EARLY DATA · PER STAT
claims.verbatim_source: "hospitals with cath labs saw about a 30% improvement in the time it takes to start threading a device"

claims.spoken: The software throws false positives, scans it flags that turn out clear.
claims.verbatim_source: "there are false positives — scans that the app will say show a large vessel occlusion that actually don't"

claims.spoken: A doctor still reviews every output, and that read decides the transfer.
claims.verbatim_source: "A doctor still reviews every output, and that official read is what drives the call to transfer or not."

claims.spoken: Alaska doesn't have consistent reporting of stroke outcomes.
claims.verbatim_source: "The state doesn't have consistent reporting of stroke outcomes."

claims.spoken: Kelly Isaacs, who runs Providence's stroke program, says she can't really show statistically significant proof it's made a big difference.
claims.verbatim_source: "Can I give you statistically significant information that RapidAI has made a big difference in the state of Alaska?" said Isaacs. "I can't, really."
requires: full question or paraphrase, never a fragment that flips meaning

claims.spoken: The coalition behind it is a volunteer group, the Alaska Stroke Coalition.
claims.verbatim_source: Labelled paraphrase, not a quotation: STAT describes the Alaska Stroke Coalition as a volunteer group of clinicians; RapidAI's release says it was founded in 2023.

reserve.text: A man in his 80s with a large vessel occlusion traveled 750 miles to Providence Anchorage (STAT); never 'flown'
reserve.why: a second case; keep the film on one patient

reserve.text: Stroke ranked fifth leading cause of death in Alaska
reserve.why: vendor source only, no state data reached

reserve.text: Ryan Wilson, ANMC neurologist: "They're gaining their brain back."
reserve.why: context unconfirmed; risks reading as an outcome claim

reserve.text: Lucy He: "the Skynet of stroke in Alaska"
reserve.why: dystopian connotation would mislead a muted viewer about tone

reserve.text: Alaska's year-one Rural Health Transformation award was $272,174,856 (Alaska DOH)
Alaska enacted a law in June setting statewide stroke and heart attack standards (STAT, paraphrase)
A family foundation's money, about four hundred fifty thousand dollars, bought it for six more hospitals.
reserve.why: cut from the VO for length; the film will not voice or paint it

reserve.text: Her colleague Kevin Myrick says they did not put it in to transfer every patient to Anchorage.
reserve.why: cut from the VO for length; the film will not voice or paint it

reserve.text: Isaacs says the distances are enormous and the weather is awful.
reserve.why: cut from the VO for length; the film will not voice or paint it

cut.why: 'all five specialists in Anchorage': not stated
anyone 'flown' in either case: not stated
45 minutes to READ a scan: it was the time to send images
any claim the software saved lives or improved outcomes: no published data
the $3.1M as RapidAI money: CMS names no vendor
